# Redix v1.5.3 - Table of Contents

> Fast, pipelined, resilient Redis driver for Elixir.

## Pages

- [Redix](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Reconnections](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/reconnections.md)
- [Real-world usage](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/real-world-usage.md)

- [Telemetry](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/telemetry.md)
- [Changelog](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [License](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Redix](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.md): This module provides the main API to interface with [Redis](http://redis.io) and
[Valkey](https://valkey.io/).
- [Redix.Cluster](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.Cluster.md): Main API for using [Redis Cluster](https://redis.io/docs/management/scaling/).
- [Redix.Protocol](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.Protocol.md): This module provides functions to work with the [Redis binary
protocol](http://redis.io/topics/protocol).

- [Redix.PubSub](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.PubSub.md): Interface for the Redis pub/sub functionality.
- [Redix.Telemetry](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for event tracing, metrics, and logging.
- [Redix.URI](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.URI.md): This module provides functions to work with a Redis URI.

- Exceptions
  - [Redix.ConnectionError](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.ConnectionError.md): Error in the connection to Redis.
  - [Redix.Error](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.Error.md): Error returned by Redis.
  - [Redix.Protocol.ParseError](https://redix.hexdocs.pm/Redix.Protocol.ParseError.md): Error in parsing data according to the
[RESP](http://redis.io/topics/protocol) protocol.
